outcome: probability of having a Caesarean section
cohort: The study included more than 620,000 deliveries in 46 municipalities from the Medical Birth Registry of Norway between 2000 and 2011.
finding: Newspaper coverage had a significant positive effect on the probability of having a Caesarean section.
mod_finding: Newspaper coverage had a significant positive effect on the probability of having a Caesarean section, indicating obstetricians' sensitivity to negative media exposure.
